solutionSql:
WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_w
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY customer_id
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_all
  FROM shipments
)
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN per_customer AS p ON p.customer_id = c.id
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_w > o.avg_all
ORDER BY c.id;
notes: Customers 2, 4 and 5 sit above the 1032.04 overall average. Customer 1 at 1020.87 is the closest customer below it.
